sentences.text:
=
 Appearance :
 For the Petitioner/s : Mr.Gautam, Advocate  For the Opposite Party/s : Mr.Sanjay Kumar, A.P.P.
 ================================

== ===
 CORAM: HONOURABLE MR. JUSTICE PRABHAT KUMAR SINGH  ORAL ORDER 9 27-02-2026 Heard learned counsel for the parties.
2. Petitioner apprehends arrest in a case registered for the offence punishable under sections 498A/34 and other allied sections of the IPC.
3.

Supplementary affidavit has been filed on behalf of the petitioner submitting that in compliance of order of the Family Court, Rohtas at Sasaram dated 14.11.2024, passed in Maintenance Case No.
133/2021, petitioner has made payment of Rs.10,000/- as interim maintenance to opposite party no.2 and her daughter.

Learned counsel submits that the petitioner undertakes to make payment of maintenance regularly to opposite party no.2.
6.
Considering the aforesaid development and undertaking of the petitioner, prayer for bail of this petitioner is allowed.

In the event of arrest/surrender within eight weeks from today, let this petitioner, mentioned above, be enlarged on bail on furnishing bail bond of Rs.10,000/- (ten thousand) with two sureties of the like amount each to the satisfaction of the Patna High Court CR.

MISC. No.47610 of 2024(9) dt.27-02-2026 Judicial Magistrate 1st class, Gaya in Mahila Police Station Case No. 52/2020, subject to the conditions laid down under section 482 of the Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023.
